items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: I played around a whole lot of like Pete Lala's in different places around there.

ctx.x: No, I played around a whole lot of like Pete Lala's in different places around there. I played around in different places but I wasn't on no side of them. Just go around and different people playing. Now, around in all in that Vicarae up there I played many places I played in.

Is there anything you can tell us about John Lala's place, the Big 25? They just tore that down a few years ago. I remember it. I never heard any music or anything. Did they have music ever at the Big 25 much?
